messages.content:
Label each claim from an incident report with its kind.
kind: action (someone did something), speech (someone said something), time (a clock time or date is stated), object (a thing, place or condition was present).
Keep every id exactly as given. Answer with JSON only: {"claims":[{"id":"C1","kind":"action"}]}

C1. A motorcycle fled from deputies during a traffic operation.
C2. The motorcycle sped at high speed, weaving in and out of traffic.
C3. The aviation unit was overhead when the rider stopped to refuel.
C4. The rider stopped to refuel at a gas station.
C5. The rider stopped voluntarily for deputies on the highway shoulder.
C6. A passenger was riding on the back of the motorcycle.
